[element-toc-div]
=== `<toc-div>` Table of Contents Division

Division, typically for the purposes of display, in a structural Table of Contents, for example, a division holding the first Part of a 3-part standard, and the titles of all the sections within that Part.

The following, in order: <<element-toc-title-group,`<toc-title-group>`>> <<element-toc-title-group,Table of Contents Title Group>>, zero or one <<element-p,`<p>`>> <<element-p,Paragraph>>, zero or more Optionally any one of: <<element-ext-link,`<ext-link>`>> <<element-ext-link,External Link>> <<element-nav-pointer,`<nav-pointer>`>> <<element-nav-pointer,Navigation Pointer>> <<element-nav-pointer-group,`<nav-pointer-group>`>> <<element-nav-pointer-group,Navigation Pointer Group>> One or more of any of: <<element-toc-entry,`<toc-entry>`>> <<element-toc-entry,Table of Contents Entry>> <<element-toc-div,`<toc-div>`>> <<element-toc-div,Table of Contents Division>>
